item.title: Mangayomi v0.9.9
item.description:
Mangayomi 0.9.9 | Mangayomi-v0.9.9-ios
## What's Changed * fix(extension): enable mobile code copy by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1039 * fix(reader): restore double-tap zoom toggle by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1037 * feat(player): add hold-and-slide speed selector by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1038 * fix(http): drop the quotes Linux wraps the saved user agent in by @matsukiender-star in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1036 * fix(security): show what deep links install and keep tokens out of sh… by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1041 * chore: await dropped writes, add guard lints, localize hardcoded strings by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1042 * refactor: move the tracker library cache from Hive to Isar by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1043 * refactor: split large widget files and remove duplicated code by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1044 * Try to fix chapter sorting by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1035 * Add a protected HLS proxy for extension playback by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1040 * Fix reader by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1051 * fix(mobile): improve player controls and error handling by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1047 * fix(restore): improve error handling and reporting during restore ope… by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1052 * fix(reader): pan a zoomed webtoon page without losing double tap by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1054 * ci: run the test suite on pull requests and main by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1056 * Use neutral icons for extension repositories by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1045 * Add western recommendations and trustworthy watch orders by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1050 * Refine portrait player controls by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1058 * fix: recognise "T1" seasons and "Episodio" episodes by @matsukiender-star in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1060 * Hide settings, that the user disabled by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1059 * fix(tv): make Browse overscan safe and focus reachable by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1061 * add useful comments to extension template by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1057
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.8...v0.9.9

item.title: Mangayomi v0.9.8
item.description:
Mangayomi 0.9.8 | Mangayomi-v0.9.8-ios
## What's Changed * fix(tracker): improve Trakt.tv multi-season mapping, watchlist, and ratings sync by @lee-gangjin in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1024 * feat(tracker): Add backlog sections (Plan to read/Watchlist), handle AniList 429 rate limits, and prioritize Trakt series by @lee-gangjin in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1030 * fix(mihon): use the Cloudflare proxy for extension-server sources by @matsukiender-star in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1026 * fix(mihon): identify which source of an extension a call is for by @matsukiender-star in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1027 * Improve LNReader extension compatibility * fix: stale chapter page lists and add WebP decoding on Linux by @MenaHere in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1031 * fix: remember window geometry on Linux; add missing libavif to AppImage to resolve closure by @MenaHere in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1032
## New Contributors * @lee-gangjin made their first contribution in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1024 * @matsukiender-star made their first contribution in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1026 * @MenaHere made their first contribution in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1031
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.7...v0.9.8
